name: Crypto Sanctions Evasion
description: Designated persons and sanctioned jurisdictions may use virtual assets to hold or move value outside the traditional banking system, via exchanges with weak controls, unhosted wallets, mixers and cross-chain swaps. Blockchain analytics, geolocation and travel rule data are the core detection tools.

sources.text: OFAC, Sanctions Compliance Guidance for the Virtual Currency Industry (2021)
FATF, Targeted Update on Implementation of the FATF Standards on Virtual Assets and VASPs (annual, 2019 onward)
OFSI, Cryptoassets Threat Assessment (July 2025); OFSI/FCA/BoE, Joint statement on sanctions and the cryptoasset sector (March 2022)

indicators.name: Wallet addresses attributed to designated persons
indicators.canon: Exposure to wallets attributed to designated, stolen-fund or illicit actors
indicators.desc: Customer transacts directly or near-directly with blockchain addresses attributed by sanctions lists or analytics to designated persons, thefts, ransomware or terrorist fundraising.
indicators.ctx: Customer transacts with addresses published in sanctions lists or attributed by analytics.

indicators.name: Access from sanctioned jurisdictions via VPN or proxy
indicators.canon: Access from sanctioned jurisdictions via VPN or proxy
indicators.desc: Technical indicators suggest the user is located in a comprehensively sanctioned area.
indicators.ctx: Technical indicators suggest the user is located in a comprehensively sanctioned area.

indicators.name: Exposure to non-compliant exchanges in sanctioned or high-risk locations
indicators.canon: Funds sent to unlicensed or weakly regulated exchanges
indicators.desc: Withdrawals or flows go to exchanges or VASPs that lack licensing or effective AML and sanctions controls.
indicators.ctx: Funds flow to or from VASPs known for weak sanctions controls.
indicators.fp: Indirect exposure is difficult to assess.

indicators.name: Use of mixers or privacy services after inbound transfers from higher-risk sources
indicators.canon: Use of mixers, chain-hopping or privacy coins
indicators.desc: Funds are moved through mixers, privacy coins or rapid cross-chain conversion to obscure origin.
indicators.ctx: Funds are obfuscated shortly after arrival.

indicators.name: Ransom or stolen funds paid to addresses linked to designated actors
indicators.canon: Wallet attributed to ransomware or theft actors
indicators.desc: Source or destination address is attributed to ransomware affiliates, theft or designated actors.
indicators.ctx: Wallets receive funds from ransomware or theft with attribution.

indicators.name: Large OTC or peer-to-peer purchases paid in cash or non-bank rails
indicators.canon: Large OTC or peer-to-peer purchases paid in cash or non-bank rails
indicators.desc: Purchases with limited traceability to source of funds.
indicators.ctx: Purchases with limited traceability to source of funds.
indicators.fp: Cash purchase happens in some markets.

indicators.name: Stablecoin use to hold value of designated person's funds
indicators.canon: Stablecoin use to hold value of designated person's funds
indicators.desc: Large stablecoin balances held with limited stated purpose by customers linked to designated persons.
indicators.ctx: Large stablecoin balances held with limited stated purpose by customers linked to designated persons.
indicators.fp: Stablecoins are widely used for savings.

indicators.name: Account sharing or intermediary accounts used by third parties
indicators.canon: Account controlled or used by someone other than the holder
indicators.desc: Signs that a third party holds the card, PIN, credentials or device, or that funds and activity belong to someone other than the named holder.
indicators.ctx: Customer account is used for third-party funds.
